scientific_integrity: Analytic proof uses published extremal area formulas and Dowker convexity; exact-rational interval checker treats the 426 finite cases. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to regular even-gonal isoperimetrices; exceptional failure is of the sufficient weak-Dowker test, not of honeycomb optimality. An unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
title: Sharp powered-Dowker thresholds and logarithmic honeycombs for regular polygonal norms
